title: Reset and enrolment signals reach the operator (R-11)
assertion: Undelivered reset requests (configuration and throttle codes), failed requests, refused enrolments and refused client credentials each have a filter and an alarm on the operator topic; reset requests per user over 5 in an hour alarm through a contributor rule keyed on the user ID, with no per-user metric; the messages are read from the app's source
noFileReason: The monitoring stack is synthesized in memory and its messages are read from the web source; synthetic personas ask for resets; no file.
